meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 技能会把项目的完整时间线按ISO周拆分成多个文件，然后依次为每一周启动一个子代理，由上一周的延续信息串联，产出按周排列的多章叙事摘要，并生成索引和可排序的编号文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”等周摘要或连续时间线叙事时触发。

say.text: 把[项目名]做成按周的连续故事
say.note: 会先按ISO周拆分时间线，再逐章生成摘要。

say.text: 生成每周摘要，从第一周开始
say.note: 第一章没有前文，直接开篇。

say.text: 最后一周写“Where We Are”结尾

howto.what_en: The skill splits a project's full claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week, each inheriting the prior week's carry-forward block, producing a multi-chapter narrative digest ordered by week, plus an index and zero-padded sortable filenames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", or similar serial timeline / narrative chapter requests.

say_en.text: Turn [project] into a week-by-week serial story
say_en.note: It splits the timeline by ISO week, then generates chapters.

say_en.text: Generate weekly digests, starting from week one
say_en.note: Chapter one opens with no prior context.

say_en.text: End the final chapter with a "Where We Are" section
say_en.note: Avoids a false ending for the ongoing story.
